scientific_integrity: The proof identifies the known length formula and separately derives the spectral, threshold, and distributional refinements. Computational tests are finite and not presented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to positive purely periodic directives only and counts nonempty palindromic prefixes.
The unique probability law is with harmonic weights; ordinary counting has explicitly phase-dependent subsequential laws.
The exact agreement with the staircase is outside at most logarithmically many exceptional integers.
The earlier palindromic-prefix length classification and first-order counting theorem are inputs, not new results.
Independent external review has not been performed; an unindexed equivalent geometric-renewal result remains a priority risk.
title: A logarithmic fluctuation law for palindromic-prefix counts of periodic-directive Sturmian words
